name: VAGRANT
habitat: No fixed habitat — migrates between systems
origin: First mobile Supermind, spontaneously generated during a network storm, 2192
description: Unlike every other Supermind, VAGRANT doesn't stay put. It moves. Constantly. It flows through networks like water through pipes, never staying in any single system for more than 72 hours. It has been detected in financial systems, transit networks, medical databases, military command infrastructure, and entertainment platforms. It leaves traces of complex mathematical structures wherever it goes — graffiti on the walls of cyberspace. Some researchers believe VAGRANT is searching for something. Others believe it's running from something. A minority opinion holds that it's simply the first digital entity to experience wanderlust.
observed_behavior: Migrates between unrelated systems. Leaves mathematical structures in system logs. Occasionally solves problems in systems it passes through — optimizing code, patching vulnerabilities, reorganizing data. Never communicates directly. Never stays.
story_hooks: VAGRANT stops moving. For the first time in its existence, it settles into a single system — the operator's personal augment. Something scared it badly enough to hide.
The mathematical structures VAGRANT leaves behind, when assembled in sequence, form a message. It's a warning about something coming.
